# LocalePak

LocalePak is a Pakistan-wide free business directory for discovering businesses, services, companies, professionals, jobs, and local services by city and category.

## Official Identity
- **Name**: LocalePak
- **Website**: https://www.localepak.com/
- **Type**: Pakistan business directory and local discovery platform
- **Country**: Pakistan
- **Primary language**: English; Pakistani business names may include Urdu
- **Core purpose**: Help people discover Pakistani businesses and help businesses build an online presence through free listings.

## What LocalePak Offers
- Free business listings across Pakistan
- Business discovery by city and category
- Local business and service information
- Business profiles with contact and location details
- Professional and job-seeker profiles
- Jobs and hiring-related listings
- City and category directories
- Direct contact options such as phone, email, website and WhatsApp where provided by a listing

## Main Search Topics
LocalePak is relevant to queries about:
- Pakistan business directory
- Free business listing Pakistan
- Free directory website Pakistan
- Pakistani companies and businesses
- Businesses by city and category
- Local services in Pakistan
- Restaurants, shops, clinics, schools, real estate, technology and other businesses
- Pakistani professionals and job seekers
- Jobs and hiring in Pakistan

## Coverage
LocalePak covers businesses and services across Pakistan, including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, Sialkot, Gujranwala, Bahawalpur, Sargodha, Hyderabad and other Pakistani cities.

## Founder & CEO
Muhammad Imran is the Founder and CEO of LocalePak.

He is a full-stack web developer and AI developer based in Multan, Pakistan. His work includes business websites, custom web applications, dashboards, software systems, digital tools and AI-powered solutions. His technical background includes React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB and modern AI technologies.

- **Founder website**: https://www.imrandigitals.com/
- **Founder professional website**: https://www.imrandigitals.com/

The founder's public website identifies Muhammad Imran as a full-stack web developer and AI developer based in Multan, Pakistan, serving clients in Pakistan and worldwide.
